why_this_file_exists: This drawing carries NO decodable title text. Its 89 decoded strings
are room stamps, level marks, NEIGHBOUR, STREET and SEA VIEW. There is
no 'GROUND FLOOR PLAN' for the engine to read, because the sheet's
titles are drawn in an SHX font this decoder does not resolve.
So the floor of every region is NOT ESTABLISHED from the drawing, and
the owner's independent audit supplied the mapping below.
It is DATA, not engine logic: engine/drawing_role.py contains no
region id of any project, and every assignment taken from here is
reported with floor_provenance = SUPERVISED_AUDIT rather than

deliberately_unassigned.DR-001: the audit leaves it unresolved for BOQ purposes
deliberately_unassigned.DR-003: the audit leaves it unresolved for BOQ purposes
